falseSynonyms.zh: 字體排印不等於 calligraphy typography 是選擇、排列和設計可重複使用的字體與文字版面；calligraphy 是以手寫筆勢形成字形的藝術。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Typography arranges type; calligraphy creates letterforms through writing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 字型不等於書法 font 是可重複使用的一套數碼／印刷字形；calligraphy 通常是手寫創作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A font is a reusable type design; calligraphy is handwritten or hand-executed lettering.

falseSynonyms.zh: 普通手寫過於寬泛 任何人寫字都是 handwriting；只有具有藝術、技巧或美學目的時才接近 calligraphy。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON All calligraphy is handwriting in a broad sense, but ordinary handwriting is not necessarily calligraphy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 草寫／連筆不等於 calligraphy cursive 是一種連筆書寫方式；calligraphy 可以用 cursive，也可以使用非連筆字體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Cursive describes a writing style; calligraphy describes an artistic practice.

falseSynonyms.zh: 繪畫不等於書法 drawing 以圖像和線條表現物件／形狀；calligraphy 的核心媒介是文字與字形。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Calligraphy may be visually expressive, but it remains centred on written forms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 繪畫不等於 calligraphy 某些文化中書畫關係密切，但 painting 和 calligraphy 是不同藝術形式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Painting creates images; calligraphy creates artistic written forms.

falseSynonyms.zh: 簽名不等於書法 簽名可以很有藝術感，但它的主要功能是身份標記，不等於整門書法藝術。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A signature may use calligraphic style without being synonymous with calligraphy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 塗鴉不等於書法 graffiti 可以包含藝術文字，但通常指公共空間的塗寫／街頭藝術；和 calligraphy 的傳統、技法與用途不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Graffiti can include stylised lettering, but it is a different artistic and social practice.
